attribution.reason: closure-free Re=2800 error 52.8% sits inside the band of the sister-case errors (54.2%); the two effects are not separable from these rows

attribution_limits.agreement_proves: the 2-D discretisation (terrain-following mesh, momentum assembly, pressure projection, bulk-velocity controller, wall-shear metric) is not the source of the Re=2800 miss, because the same code path with the same mesh family reproduces a published reattachment length at a lower Reynolds number
attribution_limits.agreement_does_not_prove: that the Re=2800 flow is two-dimensional: 2-D-vs-3-D physics at Re=2800 remains an open explanation for the residual, and only a 3-D (or LES/DNS) run can separate it
attribution_limits.disagreement_proves: at least one of {discretisation, 2-D-vs-3-D modelling, reference interpretation} is responsible; a single mismatched Re does not say which
attribution_limits.reference_caveat: the KB numbers are from a 3-D DNS (LESOCC); a 2-D closure-free run cannot reproduce 3-D turbulence, so the comparison is a framework test only where the flow is genuinely two-dimensional (Re=700 is the strongest such candidate; Re=1400 is marginal)
